text.aria-label: Title text 'Coverage by phase of an injected load-shift: 3, 7, 15, and 30 day events, both metering groups, 24-120 h ahead Dot: mean over Primary-events. Line: 95% interval from resampling events. Dashed: the 0.90 target. Higher is better.'
text.tspan: Coverage by phase of an injected load-shift: 3, 7, 15, and 30 day events, both metering groups, 24-120 h ahead
Dot: mean over Primary-events. Line: 95% interval from resampling events. Dashed: the 0.90 target. Higher is better.
